crossRefs.note: No man will be able to stand before you all the days of your life. As I was with Moses, so I will be with you. I will…
Yahweh do so to Jonathan, and more also, should it please my father to do you evil, if I don’t disclose it to you, and…
As Yahweh has been with my lord the king, even so may he be with Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne…
David said to Solomon his son, “Be strong and courageous, and do it. Don’t be afraid, nor be dismayed; for Yahweh God…
May Yahweh answer you in the day of trouble. May the name of the God of Jacob set you up on high,
May he grant you your heart’s desire, and fulfill all your counsel.
Save, Yahweh! Let the King answer us when we call!
Save us now, we beg you, Yahweh! Yahweh, we beg you, send prosperity now.
Blessed is he who comes in Yahweh’s name! We have blessed you out of Yahweh’s house.
The multitudes who went in front of him, and those who followed, kept shouting, “Hosanna to the son of David! Blessed…
I exhort therefore, first of all, that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and givings of thanks be made for all men:
for kings and all who are in high places, that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and reverence.

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Just as we listened to Moses in all things, so will we listen to you. Only may Yahweh your God be with you, as he was with Moses.
translations.bsb: Just as we obeyed Moses in all things, so we will obey you. And may the LORD your God be with you, as He was with Moses.
translations.kjv: According as we hearkened unto Moses in all things, so will we hearken unto thee: only the LORD thy God be with thee, as he was with Moses.
translations.asv: According as we hearkened unto Moses in all things, so will we hearken unto thee: only Jehovah thy God be with thee, as he was with Moses.
